notes: Nocturne brings obsidian surfaces, silver typography and restrained blue light to desktop and Android.
Android gains refined Chat, Projects, Home and Signals screens, plus updated pairing, memory, libraries, launcher and widget.
Raevin uses a natural charcoal raven with blue wing particles and 32 smoothly blended gestures.
Desktop chat, workspace, Build Studio, memory, model setup and quick commands share the new visual direction.
Reduced motion, phone lifecycle and battery-saving behavior remain supported.
The app keeps its existing pairing, package identity and Hey Atlas wake phrase. Repeated wake detection remains experimental.
